periods.time: After the Three Harmonies become Lux's guards
periods.summary: Lux rewards Sharis, Tillfur and Noct for becoming his official guards by turning a return trip into a one-day graduation trip in Rairel Town. They sightsee, eat, drink and acknowledge their complicated affection for Lux while choosing to remain by him as guards.
periods.cause: The Three Harmonies plan a graduation trip and volunteer to serve as Lux's royal guards during his one-year reign.
periods.process: They tour Rairel Town, visit attractions and a casino, drink at the inn, tease Lux, and later care for him after he passes out in the bath.
periods.outcome: The three strengthen their guard-friend bond with Lux while quietly admitting feelings they will not openly pursue yet.
periods.aftermath: They return to Crossfield carrying a shared secret about that night.
periods.significance: Transforms the Three Harmonies from school friends into Lux's official guard unit while preserving their personal attachment.
